cells.comment:
Create a raster grid of positions and visit each one
(simulates a 4x3 = 12-well plate scan)
cells.code:
import numpy as np
import time

origin = [56, 100]   # coordinates of first position
steps  = [25, -25]   # x and y offsets to next item

grid = np.array([(x, y)
                 for y in range(3)
                 for x in range(4)]) * steps + origin

for p in grid:
    stage.move_absolute(p[0], p[1], 10)
    print('At:', stage.get_position())
    time.sleep(0.2)   # pause at each well

stage.move_absolute(origin[0], origin[1], 10)
print('Back to origin')
